name: 平交道
description: 屏東鄉間的台鐵平交道（Godot 4 網頁匯出）：Claude 思考時警報響、柵欄放下、列車在遠處等；工作時列車一節一節開過去，工作多久就開多久；做完最後一節通過、柵欄升起；等你時列車停在平交道上。跟著時鐘從白天走到黃昏、夜晚。原始碼在 godot/crossing/。
description_en: A Taiwan Railway level crossing in the Pingtung countryside (Godot 4 web export): when Claude thinks the bells ring and the barriers drop; while it works the train rolls past car by car, for as long as it works; when it finishes the last car passes and the barriers lift; while it waits for you the train stops at the crossing. Follows the clock from day to dusk to night.
